title: What is a basket crane?
lines: A basket crane is a knuckle boom crane on a truck, with a person basket at the tip.
The same crane that lowers a water heater also lifts a sign installer to the fourth floor.
Measure height and distance from the sidewalk, not the wall, and add three to four meters of margin.
Check power lines, room for the outriggers, and ground that will not sink.
The full guide is on tal83.com.
